AUF/IFIC virtual mobility grant is a consortium distance-learning tuition support scheme across many francophone institutions (licence to doctorat). No single supervising professor or institution is attached to the award; outcome not applicable.

Qatar University International Students Scholarship is a competitive undergraduate (bachelor's) merit award administered by the Scholarships Section of the Office of the VP for Student Affairs. The official scholarship types page confirms eligibility is limited to international students applying to undergraduate programs (transfer, visiting, non-degree and second-degree applicants excluded). No supervising professor or faculty tie is published for the award, and undergraduate study has no supervisor structure. Official page verified live: https://www.qu.edu.qa/en-us/students/admission/scholarships/types.

Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship (BDGS) is a national government scheme administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs covering study at several Brunei institutions (UBD, UNISSA, UTB, KUPU SB, Politeknik Brunei). No specific supervising professor is attached to the award; outcome not applicable.
